notes: Provenance for covers that shipped with no source record. Twelve race and Space covers had no manifest record whose output hash matched the file; they were first committed in #1631 (2026-07-16) and #1690 (2026-07-20) and are byte-identical to those commits. Ten are traced here to exact free Unsplash photographs (Unsplash License; the API reports premium: false), each confirmed by aligning the 2400 px download to the shipped file (alignment score 0.993 or more, mean pixel difference 3.2 or less at 160 px wide, against about 70-107 for a different photograph of the same landmark) and by eye side by side. The shipped files were made from the operator's own July downloads, so they are not re-encodes of today's downloads, and each crop is recovered in the 2400 px download's coordinates. Not traced after text, photographer and image searches: space-the-big-half and space-london-10000; their licence is unknown and a licensed replacement of each is proposed, for the owner to choose. space-royal-parks-half is licensed correctly, but nothing in the photograph or its caption shows that it is Hyde Park (see its record).

images.unsplashCaption: a line of trees and sunlight (no description)
images.subject: Rows of plane trees on a lawn with the low sun breaking through the trunks and long shadows.
images.locationEvidence: NOT CONFIRMED. The caption ("a line of trees and sunlight") names no place, the photo has no GPS data, and nothing in the frame is a recognisable Hyde Park landmark - only rows of trees on grass. The photographer is France-based and the camera clock was set to UTC+2 (CEST, 21 Aug 2018 19:32 local), which points away from London (BST is UTC+1) rather than towards it. The 2026-07-20 commit called it "Hyde Park plane trees" on the operator's say-so. The licence is clean; whether it shows the race's park is unproven.
